covered_report_window: Monday, July 27, 2026 after U.S. market close plus Tuesday, July 28, 2026 before U.S. market open
market_context_summary: The run occurred while the U.S. market was open on July 27, so the strict actionable window is July 27 AMC plus July 28 BMO. Macro context is mixed: oil fell sharply after U.S.-Iran tension eased, but markets are still braced for a heavy Fed and mega-cap earnings week with AI capex, rates, and guidance quality driving risk appetite.

top_setups.notes: Final rankings are consensus outputs from three fully independent research passes.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Nucor has the cleanest positive setup because company guidance already implies a material EPS step-up and the next driver is whether steel pricing commentary extends that strength.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Nucor guided Q2 EPS to $4.70-$4.80, above several calendar consensus marks, and confirmed a July 27 after-close release.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Adjusted EPS above the preannounced range, stronger steel mill pricing, stable volumes, constructive Q3 demand, or capital return support.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Investors may sell the news because the Q2 EPS range is known, especially if Q3 pricing or volumes look softer.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; reversal risk is mainly sell-the-news and cyclicality risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Company guidance reset the earnings bar higher; the key is forward commentary rather than headline EPS.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Coca-Cola leans up because Q1 showed resilient volume and organic revenue strength, and the market should reward confirmation that demand can hold despite macro noise.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The company confirmed July 28 before-NYSE-open timing; Q1 organic revenue grew 10% and full-year guidance was updated.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Solid unit case volume, sustained price/mix, resilient margins, and unchanged or raised full-year EPS guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A good quarter can still fade if organic growth decelerates sharply, FX hurts reported numbers, or volumes show elasticity pressure.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; lower-beta staples profile reduces opposite-direction risk versus AI names.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published previews center on organic revenue, margins, and whether the raised 2026 EPS outlook remains intact.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: F5 leans up because software, security, and AI-related traffic demand can support guidance, while the recent pullback makes the setup less crowded.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: F5 confirmed July 27 after-close results and a 4:30 p.m. ET webcast; previews show roughly $4.00 EPS and about $834M revenue expected.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Stronger software subscriptions, security demand, systems recovery, and FY2026 guidance support.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A reported beat could still fail if hardware demand softens, services slow, or management guides conservatively.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; recent weakness lowers but does not remove reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The bar appears reasonable rather than washed out; guide quality matters more than Q3 EPS alone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Celestica has strong AI infrastructure momentum, but the stock needs a beat-and-raise quality update rather than just good reported growth.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Celestica confirmed July 27 after-close timing; previews point to very strong expected year-over-year revenue and EPS growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Hyperscale AI demand, stronger CCS revenue, durable margins, and an upgraded FY2026 outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Even a solid print can reverse if margins, AI order visibility, or guide magnitude fails elevated expectations.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; AI infrastructure crowding raises reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published previews imply the market already expects large growth, so guidance quality is decisive.

ranked_companies.timing: Jul 27, 2026 after close; webcast 5:00 p.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Cadence has excellent AI/EDA demand exposure, but the consensus view stayed below allocation threshold because valuation and forward-guide risk are high.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Cadence confirmed July 27 Q2 webcast timing; Q1 results showed revenue and non-GAAP EPS growth and raised FY2026 guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Above-guide Q2 revenue, resilient backlog, AI design activity, and reaffirmed or raised FY revenue/EPS outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A good quarter can still fall if bookings, China, Hexagon integration, or margin guidance disappoints the premium multiple.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; valuation and AI/EDA crowding drive high reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The bar is elevated after raised FY guidance; the stock-moving metric is guide quality, not EPS alone.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: UHS leans up modestly because expectations look reset and Q1 showed revenue and EPS strength, but payer mix and labor costs keep conviction contained.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: UHS confirmed it will report Q2 after the July 27 close; recent previews note Q1 revenue growth and EPS beat context.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Acute-care volume growth, behavioral health stabilization, labor cost discipline, and maintained outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A fine quarter could fall if wage pressure, payer mix, or volume commentary worsens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable implied move used; rebound from a depressed share-price base adds two-way risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence supports a mild relief setup but not a high-conviction edge.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Corning has real AI optical demand, but the stock appears vulnerable because expectations and the implied reaction bar look high after a large AI-driven rerating.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: MarketBeat lists July 28 before-open timing, $0.76 EPS, and $4.63B revenue expected; recent coverage noted options pricing around a 10% move and strong AI optical focus.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Optical Communications acceleration, hyperscaler agreement expansion, and raised core sales/EPS guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any indication that AI optical demand is already in expectations, margin conversion is weaker, or sequential growth slows could trigger a sell-the-news move.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Investing.com reported options pricing for roughly a 10% earnings move, increasing reversal and event-volatility risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent previews point to modest estimate optimism, so the published bar may understate buy-side expectations.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Welltower leans down because the senior-housing growth story is well known and the stock likely needs exceptional SHOP NOI and FFO guidance to extend.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Welltower confirmed July 27 after-NYSE-close timing; MarketBeat shows after-close timing and consensus EPS around $0.64, while REIT investors will focus more on normalized FFO and operating metrics.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Seniors housing occupancy, RevPOR, NOI, acquisitions, and FFO guidance outperform elevated expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A good quarter can still fade if valuation, cap rates, or any slower senior-housing momentum dominate.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; reversal risk is valuation and high-expectation driven.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The key metric is not EPS but normalized FFO and SHOP operating momentum.

ranked_companies.timing: Jul 28, 2026 before open; call 8:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: PayPal leans down because branded checkout growth and transaction-margin quality remain the decisive metrics, and Q1 improvement still looked incremental.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: PayPal IR confirms a July 28 8:00 a.m. ET Q2 call; Q1 net revenue rose 7%, but transaction margin dollars rose only 3%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Branded checkout acceleration, Venmo strength, enterprise growth, and TM$ growth above expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Soft branded checkout, take-rate pressure, or guidance implying the turnaround is still slow.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used; compressed expectations and takeover chatter raise relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The key metric is transaction margin quality, not headline revenue growth.

ranked_companies.timing: Jul 28, 2026 before open; call 10:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Royal Caribbean leans down only modestly because EPS is expected to decline and fuel risk remains visible, but lower oil and strong bookings could easily reverse the trade.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: RCL confirmed a July 28 10:00 a.m. ET call; previews show roughly $3.98 EPS and $4.82B revenue expected, with EPS down year over year despite revenue growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings, onboard spend, yield, and lower fuel commentary support a relief move.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: EPS decline, fuel cost pressure, consumer softness, or conservative guide could pressure the stock.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable implied move used; oil's sharp drop raises opposite-direction relief risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The market will likely care more about booking/yield and cost guidance than headline EPS alone.

ranked_companies.timing: Jul 28, 2026 before open; call 10:30 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Boeing leans down because free cash flow and production-rate commentary remain fragile, but a low consensus loss and strong order/delivery headlines create high reversal risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Boeing confirmed July 28 results and a 10:30 a.m. ET call; Q1 revenue rose to $22.2B, operating cash flow was negative, and backlog reached $695B.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Deliveries, 737/787 production, free cash flow bridge, and 777X commentary improve enough to support relief.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any weak FCF, production constraint, certification delay, or cautious outlook can overwhelm a headline beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable implied move used; low-bar turnaround dynamics create high opposite-direction risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus loss expectations make guidance and cash flow more important than EPS.

ranked_companies.timing: Jul 28, 2026 before open; call 9:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Hilton has downside risk if RevPAR guidance softens, but the consensus did not clear the directional threshold because fee growth and travel resilience remain credible offsets.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Hilton confirmed July 28 before-open timing; Q1 materials and industry coverage point to 2%-3% full-year systemwide RevPAR growth guidance and adjusted EBITDA focus.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: RevPAR, development pipeline, fee growth, and EBITDA guide remain resilient.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: U.S. leisure softness, weaker business travel, or reduced RevPAR outlook pressures valuation.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied move used.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The stock-moving metric is RevPAR and EBITDA guidance, not headline EPS.
